title: Human papillomavirus vaccination coverage among adolescent girls and young women living with HIV in low- and middle-income countries: A systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Human Papilloma Virus (HPV)-attributable cancers disproportionately affect adolescent girls and young women living with HIV (AGYWLHIV) in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet HPV vaccination coverage in this subpopulation remains suboptimal. This systematic review and meta-analysis estimated the pooled prevalence of HPV vaccination coverage among AGYWLHIV in LMICs. METHODS: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature (CINAHL), and Web of Science for observational studies published between January 2014 and December 2025. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to estimate the pooled prevalence of HPV vaccination coverage. Subgroup analyses by age group and vaccine type were conducted, while HPV vaccination delivery platforms were summarised descriptively. Publication bias and sensitivity analyses were also performed, and statistical heterogeneity was evaluated using the I2 statistic. RESULTS: A total of 8 studies involving 1,059 AGYWLHIV were included in the meta-analysis. The pooled HPV vaccination coverage among AGYWLHIV in LMICs was 28.6% (95% CI: 20.3%-38.7%) based on a random-effects model, with substantial heterogeneity across studies (I2 = 87.0%, p < 0.0001). Exploratory subgroup analysis by age yielded HPV vaccination coverage of 90.3% (95% CI: 74.2%-98.0%) among participants aged 9-14 years (1 study; n = 31) and 19.2% (95% CI: 11.0%-31.4%) among those aged 15-26 years (4 studies; n = 250). Exploratory descriptive findings indicated that HPV vaccination was delivered through health facilities, schools, community outreach, and combinations of these approaches. However, differences in denominators limited direct comparisons between delivery platforms. CONCLUSION: The available evidence from studies conducted in LMICs indicates low HPV vaccination coverage among AGYWLHIV. Integrating HPV vaccination into routine HIV care may represent a potentially useful strategy to improve access and reduce missed vaccination opportunities among AGYWLHIV and should be further evaluated alongside broader efforts supported by strong political commitment and multisectoral collaboration. PROSPERO Number: CRD420251068971.

abstract_zh: 简介:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 引起的癌症对低收入和中等收入国家 (LMIC) 感染艾滋病毒 (AGYWLHIV) 的少女和年轻女性影响尤为严重,但该亚群中的 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率仍然不理想。这项系统回顾和荟萃分析估计了中低收入国家 AGYWLHIV 中 HPV 疫苗接种 的汇总 患病率 覆盖率。方法:在 PubMed、Scopus、护理和联合健康文献累积索引 (CINAHL) 和 Web of Science 中对 2014 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的观察性研究进行系统检索。使用随机效应荟萃分析来估计 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率的汇总 患病率。按年龄组和 疫苗 类型进行亚组分析,同时对 HPV 疫苗接种 递送平台进行描述性总结。还进行了发表偏倚和敏感性分析,并使用 I2 统计量评估了统计异质性。结果:荟萃分析共纳入 8 项研究,涉及 1,059 例 AGYWLHIV。根据随机效应模型,中低收入国家 AGYWLHIV 中的汇总 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率为 28.6%(95% CI:20.3%-38.7%),各研究之间存在显着异质性(I2 = 87.0%,p < 0.0001)。按年龄进行的探索性亚组分析得出,9-14 岁参与者(1 项研究;n = 31)中 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率为 90.3%(95% CI:74.2%-98.0%),15-26 岁参与者中 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率为 19.2%(95% CI:11.0%-31.4%)(4 项研究;n = 250)。探索性描述性研究结果表明,HPV 疫苗接种 是通过卫生设施、学校、社区外展以及这些方法的组合来传播的。然而,分母的差异限制了交付平台之间的直接比较。结论:来自中低收入国家研究的现有证据表明 AGYWLHIV 中 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率较低。将 HPV 疫苗接种 纳入常规 HIV 护理可能是一种潜在有用的策略,可改善 AGYWLHIV 患者的获取机会并减少错失的 疫苗接种 机会,并且应与强有力的政治承诺和多部门合作支持的更广泛努力一起进行进一步评估。普洛斯彼罗编号:CRD420251068971。

title: Human Papillomavirus Knowledge and Vaccine Receptiveness of County Hospital Otolaryngology Patients
abstract: ABSTRACT Objective This study evaluates human papillomavirus (HPV) knowledge and vaccine receptiveness among patients at an otolaryngology clinic in a county hospital setting. Methods Surveys were provided to adult patients between September 2023 and July 2026. Surveys were offered in English and Spanish and assessed awareness of HPV, knowledge of association with cervical and oropharyngeal cancers, and willingness to undergo HPV vaccination. Demographic data including sex, age, race/ethnicity, vaccination status, and HPV‐related disease were also collected. Chi‐squared and Fisher's exact test compared differences between males and females. Results Two hundred and one patients completed the questionnaire with demographic data available in 86. Most were Spanish‐speaking, female, Hispanic, and not vaccinated against HPV. 52.2% (105/201) had heard of HPV while 25.1% (50/199) knew HPV could cause oropharyngeal cancer. Almost three‐fifths had not heard of the HPV vaccine (60.2%, 121/201), but if offered, 33.0% (64/194) were open to receiving it. Compared with males, females were statistically more likely to have heard of HPV, understand its association with cervical and oropharyngeal cancer, and believe in the HPV vaccine's efficacy. There were no statistical differences by sex in willingness to receive the vaccine, if offered. Conclusion There is low HPV health literacy and vaccination rates among this county otolaryngology clinic population. Despite this, these patients are highly receptive to receiving the vaccine if offered. Patient education and point‐of‐care HPV vaccination at otolaryngology visits represent a highly feasible, scalable intervention to bypass primary care barriers and reduce HPV‐related disease. Level of Evidence N/A

abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 本研究评估县医院耳鼻喉科诊所患者的 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 知识和 疫苗 接受度。方法 在 2023 年 9 月至 2026 年 7 月期间向成年患者提供调查。调查以英语和西班牙语进行,评估了 HPV 的认知度、与宫颈癌和口咽癌相关的知识以及接受 HPV 疫苗接种 的意愿。还收集了人口统计数据,包括性别、年龄、种族/民族、疫苗接种 状态和 HPV 相关疾病。卡方和费舍尔精确检验比较了男性和女性之间的差异。结果 201 名患者完成了调查问卷,其中 86 名患者获得了人口统计数据。大多数患者是讲西班牙语的女性、西班牙裔,且未接种 HPV 疫苗。52.2% (105/201) 听说过 HPV,而 25.1% (50/199) 知道 HPV 可能导致口咽癌。近五分之三的人没有听说过 HPV 疫苗 (60.2%,121/201),但如果提供的话,33.0% (64/194) 愿意接受。与男性相比,从统计数据来看,女性更有可能听说过 HPV、了解其与宫颈癌和口咽癌的关联,并相信 HPV 疫苗 的功效。如果提供 疫苗,则接受 疫苗 的意愿不存在性别差异。结论 该县耳鼻咽喉科门诊人群HPV健康素养和疫苗接种率较低。尽管如此,如果提供的话,这些患者非常愿意接受 疫苗。患者教育和耳鼻喉科就诊时的 HPV 疫苗接种 护理点代表了一种高度可行、可扩展的干预措施,可以绕过初级保健障碍并减少 HPV 相关疾病。证据水平 不适用

title: Prevalence and Concordance of HPV Infection at Anogenital Sites Among Chinese Women Aged 18–45 Years With Different Cervical Lesions
abstract: ABSTRACT Human papillomavirus (HPV) is associated with multiple cancers, but evidence on its prevalence and genotype distribution across anogenital sites remains limited. We analyzed baseline data from a Phase III clinical trial of a nine‐valent HPV vaccine conducted in China, between September and December 2020. About 9327 healthy women aged 18–45 years were enrolled. Cervical, vulvar, and perianal swabs were collected for HPV genotyping. Cervical cytology was evaluated by pathologists. Women with abnormal cytology underwent colposcopy and, if indicated, biopsy for histopathological diagnosis. In our study, approximately 12.6% (1174/9327) of participants had abnormal cervical cytology, and 2.1% (194/9324) were diagnosed with CIN1+. Among the three anatomical sites, HPV prevalence was highest in the vulva (22.43%), followed by the perianal area (17.65%) and the cervix (14.15%). Multiple HPV infections were more common at noncervical sites (vulva: 33.17%; perianal: 30.19%) than at the cervix (24.94%). Participants with cervical HPV infection were more likely to have concurrent vulvar or perianal infection; HPV16 accounted for the highest proportion of three‐site infections (47.26%). Furthermore, while the consistency of high‐risk HPV types across the three anatomical sites was moderate in the overall trial population, the kappa values were markedly higher in participants with abnormal cytology. This study provides a comprehensive assessment of HPV prevalence and type distribution across multiple anogenital sites in Chinese women aged 18–45 years and serves as an essential baseline for evaluating the multi‐site impact of HPV vaccination and for informing future cervical cancer screening and surveillance strategies.

elements_en.main_results: HPV prevalence was highest in the vulva (22.43%), followed by the perianal area (17.65%) and the cervix (14.15%). Multiple HPV infections were more common at noncervical sites, and HPV16 accounted for the highest proportion of three-site infections (47.26%).
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provides a comprehensive assessment of HPV prevalence and type distribution across multiple anogenital sites in Chinese women, serving as a baseline for evaluating the multi-site impact of HPV vaccination and informing future cervical cancer screening and surveillance strategies.

title_zh: 中国18-45岁不同宫颈病变女性肛门生殖器部位HPV感染患病率及一致性
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Human papillomavirus (HPV) is associated with multiple cancers, but evidence on its prevalence and genotype distribution across anogenital sites remains limited. We analyzed baseline data from a Phase III clinical trial of a nine‐valent HPV vaccine conducted in China, between September and December 2020. About 9327 healthy women aged 18–45 years were enrolled. Cervical, vulvar, and perianal swabs were collected for HPV genotyping. Cervical cytology was evaluated by pathologists. Women with abnormal cytology underwent colposcopy and, if indicated, biopsy for histopathological diagnosis. In our study, approximately 12.6% (1174/9327) of participants had abnormal cervical cytology, and 2.1% (194/9324) were diagnosed with CIN1+. Among the three anatomical sites, HPV prevalence was highest in the vulva (22.43%), followed by the perianal area (17.65%) and the cervix (14.15%). Multiple HPV infections were more common at noncervical sites (vulva: 33.17%; perianal: 30.19%) than at the cervix (24.94%). Participants with cervical HPV infection were more likely to have concurrent vulvar or perianal infection; HPV16 accounted for the highest proportion of three‐site infections (47.26%). Furthermore, while the consistency of high‐risk HPV types across the three anatomical sites was moderate in the overall trial population, the kappa values were markedly higher in participants with abnormal cytology. This study provides a comprehensive assessment of HPV prevalence and type distribution across multiple anogenital sites in Chinese women aged 18–45 years and serves as an essential baseline for evaluating the multi‐site impact of HPV vaccination and for informing future cervical cancer screening and surveillance strategies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 与多种癌症相关,但有关其 患病率 和肛门生殖器部位基因型分布的证据仍然有限。我们分析了 2020 年 9 月至 12 月在中国进行的九价 HPV 疫苗 III 期临床试验的基线数据。约 9327 名 18-45 岁的健康女性入组。收集宫颈、外阴和肛周拭子进行 HPV 基因分型。宫颈细胞学检查由病理学家进行评估。细胞学异常的女性接受阴道镜检查,如果有需要,则进行组织病理学 诊断 活检。在我们的研究中,大约 12.6% (1174/9327) 的参与者有宫颈细胞学异常,2.1% (194/9324) 被诊断为 CIN1+。在三个解剖部位中,HPV 患病率在外阴最高(22.43%),其次是肛周区域(17.65%)和子宫颈(14.15%)。多重 HPV 感染在非宫颈部位(外阴:33.17%;肛周:30.19%)比宫颈部位(24.94%)更常见。患有宫颈 HPV 感染的参与者更有可能并发外阴或肛周感染;HPV16在三部位感染中所占比例最高(47.26%)。此外,虽然整个试验人群中三个解剖部位的高危 HPV 类型的一致性中等,但细胞学异常的参与者的 kappa 值明显较高。本研究对 18-45 岁中国女性的 HPV 患病率 和多个肛门生殖部位的类型分布进行了全面评估,并作为评估 HPV 疫苗接种 的多部位影响的重要基线,并为未来的 宫颈癌 筛查和 监测 策略提供信息。

title: Shiitake Mushroom Extract (AHCC®): Enhancing Clearance of HPV Infection with Clinical Evidence
abstract: Abstract Persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection underlies a wide spectrum of anogenital disease, including genital warts, intraepithelial neoplasia, and HPV-related malignancy. Although prophylactic vaccination is highly effective, it does not provide therapeutic benefit for established infection, highlighting the need for adjunctive strategies that enhance host antiviral immunity. Active Hexose Correlated Compound (AHCC®), a standardized extract derived from Lentinula edodes mycelia, has demonstrated immunomodulatory and immunoenhancing effects through regulation of cytokine signalling and activation of natural killer and T-cell responses. Pilot clinical studies and subsequent randomized clinical investigations in women with persistent high-risk HPV infection have shown significantly higher viral clearance rates with AHCC® compared with placebo, accompanied by normalization of immune biomarkers. In patients treated for condyloma acuminata, AHCC® supplementation has been associated with reduced recurrence. Although clinical data in men are lacking, the shared immunopathogenesis of cervical and penile HPV infection supports a plausible role for AHCC® in male genital disease, including genital warts and penile intraepithelial neoplasia. AHCC® therefore represents a promising, safe immunomodulatory adjunct in HPV-related dermatoses that warrants further investigation in male cohorts.

abstract_zh: 摘要 持续性 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染是多种肛门生殖器疾病的基础,包括生殖器疣、上皮内瘤变和 HPV 相关恶性肿瘤。尽管预防性 疫苗接种 非常有效,但它不能为已确定的感染提供治疗益处,这突出表明需要增强 宿主 抗病毒药物 免疫力的辅助策略。活性己糖相关化合物 (AHCC®) 是一种从香菇菌丝体中提取的标准化提取物,通过调节细胞因子信号传导以及激活自然杀伤细胞和 T 细胞反应,具有免疫调节和免疫增强作用。对持续 高危型HPV 感染的女性进行的试点临床研究和随后的随机临床研究表明,与安慰剂相比,AHCC® 的病毒清除率显着更高,同时免疫生物标志物正常化。在接受尖锐湿疣治疗的患者中,补充 AHCC® 与减少复发有关。尽管缺乏男性临床数据,但宫颈和阴茎 HPV 感染的共同免疫发病机制支持 AHCC® 在男性生殖器疾病(包括生殖器疣和阴茎上皮内瘤变)中的合理作用。因此,AHCC® 代表了一种治疗 HPV 相关皮肤病的有前途、安全的免疫调节辅助剂,值得在男性 队列研究 中进行进一步研究。

title: Vitamin D Hormones Modulate Oxidative Stress and Apoptosis in HPV16‐Positive SiHa Cervical Cancer Cells
abstract: ABSTRACT Cervical cancer is the fourth most prevalent malignancy among women worldwide and disproportionately affects women in resource‐constrained countries. Treatment outcomes remain limited by tumour resistance and delayed diagnosis, often resulting in advanced disease. This study investigated vitamin D‐induced oxidative stress, perturbation of oxidative signalling pathways, and apoptosis in SiHa cervical cancer cells. Cells were treated with physiological and supraphysiological concentrations of 25‐hydroxyvitamin D 3 [25(OH)D 3 ] and calcipotriol, a synthetic vitamin D receptor agonist. At physiological concentrations, both treatments supported cell survival. Supraphysiological 25(OH)D 3 induced modest mitochondrial stress, consistent with early‐to‐intermediate apoptotic changes. In contrast, supraphysiological calcipotriol induced pronounced oxidative stress and mitochondrial depolarisation, reduced cellular antioxidant capacity, and promoted biochemical and morphological features of apoptosis. These effects were accompanied by significant downregulation of relative protein expression within the MAPK, AKT and NF‐κB signalling pathways, consistent with progression towards late apoptosis. Collectively, these findings demonstrate dose‐dependent pro‐oxidative and pro‐apoptotic effects of vitamin D‐related compounds in cervical cancer cells.
journal: Journal of Biochemical and Molecular Toxicology

This study investigated vitamin D‐induced oxidative stress, perturbation of oxidative signalling pathways, and apoptosis in SiHa cervical cancer cells. Cells were treated with physiological and supraphysiological concentrations of 25‐hydroxyvitamin D 3 [25(OH)D 3 ] and calcipotriol, a synthetic vitamin D receptor agonist. At physiological concentrations, both treatments supported cell survival. Supraphysiological 25(OH)D 3 induced modest mitochondrial stress, consistent with early‐to‐intermediate apoptotic changes. In contrast, supraphysiological calcipotriol induced pronounced oxidative stress and mitochondrial depolarisation, reduced cellular antioxidant capacity, and promoted biochemical and morphological features of apoptosis. These effects were accompanied by significant downregulation of relative protein expression within the MAPK, AKT and NF‐κB signalling pathways, consistent with progression towards late apoptosis. Collectively, these findings demonstrate dose‐dependent pro‐oxidative and pro‐apoptotic effects of vitamin D‐related compounds in cervical cancer cells.

abstract_zh: 摘要 宫颈癌 是全球女性中第四大最常见的恶性肿瘤,对资源有限国家的女性影响尤为严重。治疗 结果仍然受到肿瘤耐药性和延迟 诊断 的限制,通常导致晚期疾病。本研究调查了维生素 D 诱导的氧化应激、氧化信号通路的扰动以及 SiHa 宫颈癌 细胞的细胞凋亡。用生理和超生理浓度的 25-羟基维生素 D 3 [25(OH)D 3 ] 和卡泊三醇(一种合成维生素 D 受体激动剂)处理细胞。在生理浓度下,治疗 均支持细胞存活。超生理学 25(OH)D 3 诱导适度的线粒体应激,与早期到中期的细胞凋亡变化一致。相反,超生理性卡泊三醇诱导明显的氧化应激和线粒体去极化,降低细胞抗氧化能力,并促进细胞凋亡的生化和形态学特征。这些效应伴随着 MAPK、AKT 和 NF-κB 信号通路内相对蛋白表达的显着下调,与晚期细胞凋亡的进展一致。总的来说,这些发现证明了维生素 D 相关化合物在 宫颈癌 细胞中具有剂量依赖性的促氧化和促凋亡作用。

title: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, vaccination, and cervical screening in Britain from 1999 to 2024: findings from the repeated cross-sectional National Surveys of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles (Natsal).
abstract: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination and cervical screening have substantially reduced overall cervical cancer risk, but differences in uptake must be quantified to inform equitable access. This study aimed to provide population-level evidence of the impact of HPV vaccination on HPV types 16 and 18 (hereafter HPV-16/18) prevalence in England, Scotland, and Wales (hereafter Britain), and uptake of cervical cancer prevention interventions (ie, vaccination and screening), 15 years after the introduction of the vaccination programme in 2008. METHODS: We conducted the National Surveys of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles (Natsal), which are nationally representative, cross-sectional population surveys with individual-level data and HPV testing of biosamples. Data from Natsal-2 (1999-2001; before the vaccination programme was introduced, and included urine biosamples), Natsal-3 (2010-12; early in the vaccination programme, and included urine biosamples), and Natsal-4 (2022-24; after the vaccination programme was established, and included vaginal swab and urine biosamples) were analysed. Age-adjusted prevalence ratios (aPRs) for HPV-16/18 infection were estimated among women eligible for routine vaccination (born from Sept 1, 1995) compared with same-aged women before the vaccination programme was introduced. Combined Natsal-4 probability and non-probability data assessed factors associated with self-reported HPV vaccination and cervical screening. FINDINGS: Among 10 418 Natsal-4 women (aged 16-59 years), 1059 women in the probability sample group (aged 18-44 years) provided usable biosamples (Natsal-2 n=1849; Natsal-3 n=2407). HPV-16/18 prevalence was 86% lower (aPR 0·14, 95% CI 0·02-0·84) among those aged 18-29 years in Natsal-4 (1·6%, 95% CI 0·3-8·2) than in Natsal-2 (8·7%, 95% CI 6·7-11·3). All HPV-16/18 infections reported in Natsal-4 occurred in unvaccinated women. Of 733 routine vaccination-eligible women, 23·0% (95% CI 19·4-27·0) reported being unvaccinated. Among 3530 women (aged 25-59 years) eligible for cervical screening, 5·3% (95% CI 4·4-6·3) reported never attending screening. Non-uptake of vaccination and screening was higher among minority ethnic groups, religious groups, and those born outside the UK. Prevalence of high-risk, non-vaccine-preventable HPV (HPV 35, 39, 51, 56, and 59) infections was 4·9% (95% CI 3·7-6·4) in the total population, without any statistically significant differences between these subgroups. Women with higher-risk sexual behaviours were more likely to both be vaccinated and attend for screening. INTERPRETATION: Britain's HPV vaccination programme has driven a dramatic decline in HPV-16/18 prevalence and WHO cervical cancer elimination targets might be achievable overall if this is sustained. However, women from minority ethnic groups, religious groups, and those not born in the UK are less likely to be vaccinated and screened while remaining at risk. It is crucial to improve the reach of prevention interventions to more equitably reduce cervical cancer morbidity and mortality. FUNDING: Wellcome Trust, Economic and Social Research Council, and the National Institute for Health Research.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to quantify the impact of HPV vaccination on HPV-16/18 prevalence and uptake of cervical cancer prevention interventions in Britain, addressing the need to inform equitable access to these interventions.

analysis.methods: The study analysed data from Natsal-2, Natsal-3, and Natsal-4, which included urine biosamples and, in Natsal-4, vaginal swab and urine biosamples, to estimate age-adjusted prevalence ratios for HPV-16/18 infection and assess factors associated with HPV vaccination and cervical screening.
analysis.main_results: The study found that HPV-16/18 prevalence was 86% lower among women aged 18-29 in Natsal-4 compared to Natsal-2, with all HPV-16/18 infections in Natsal-4 occurring in unvaccinated women. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted that Britain's HPV vaccination programme has significantly reduced HPV-16/18 prevalence, but non-uptake of vaccination and screening remains higher among minority ethnic groups, religious groups, and those born outside the UK, highlighting the need for improved reach of prevention interventions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that sustained HPV vaccination programmes could achieve WHO cervical cancer elimination targets, but efforts are needed to ensure equitable access and uptake among all population subgroups.

title: Human papillomavirus vaccination as treatment for cutaneous diseases: beyond prevention.
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) causes cutaneous diseases ranging from common warts to cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. Although HPV vaccines were licensed to prevent anogenital infections, they are increasingly used off-label to treat established HPV-associated cutaneous lesions. This narrative review evaluates therapeutic HPV vaccination for recalcitrant warts, nonmelanoma skin cancer and immunocompromised populations. The only large randomized controlled trial showed no benefit for anogenital warts, and all positive evidence derives from low-quality studies with small sample sizes and heterogeneous designs. Publication bias is likely. Key challenges include lack of coverage for oncogenic β-HPV subtypes and the off-label nature of therapy. Future directions require next-generation vaccines targeting cutaneous HPV types and well-designed trials. Pending robust data, therapeutic HPV vaccination should remain strictly investigational and should be offered only within the context of clinical research or after explicit shared decision making, rather than as a routine clinical option.

title: Cervical cancer risk reduction in the era of human papillomavirus vaccination.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination status is important to consider when evaluating the population-level impact of cervical screening uptake on cervical cancer risk, yet screening rates are rarely presented by vaccination status, limiting assessments of population-level protection against cervical cancer. METHODS: Using females 21-39 years old from the 2019 National Health Interview Survey (N = 4000), the authors report the proportion up-to-date with cervical screening stratified by age and self-reported HPV vaccination status. Using assumptions of 85% and 70% reduction in cervical cancer risk from HPV vaccination and up-to-date screening status, respectively, the authors explore the population-level reduction in cervical cancer risk from varying screening coverage by HPV vaccination status. RESULTS: A total of 78.4% of females were up-to-date with screening, 38.0% reported ever receiving an HPV vaccine, and 15.3% were both unvaccinated and not up-to-date with screening. Across age groups, the proportion of females up-to-date with screening was 6.3%-19.1% higher for vaccinated versus unvaccinated females. The relative reduction in cervical cancer risk from vaccination and screening ranged from 62.1% for females 36-39 years old to 73.1% for females 26-30 years old, compared to the absence of vaccination and screening. Despite females 21-25 years old having the lowest screening uptake, their reduction in cervical cancer risk was not the lowest due to higher vaccination levels. CONCLUSIONS: Cervical screening rates are higher among females who were vaccinated against HPV, resulting in a higher population-level risk of cervical cancer than expected from considering vaccination and screening rates independently. Including vaccination status in national surveillance data sets would help identify and target interventions within communities at higher risk.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the impact of HPV vaccination status on cervical screening uptake and cervical cancer risk, addressing the need to consider vaccination status in assessing population-level protection against cervical cancer.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used data from the 2019 National Health Interview Survey, involving 4000 females aged 21-39, to stratify cervical screening uptake by age and HPV vaccination status.
analysis.methods: The authors analyzed self-reported HPV vaccination status and cervical screening uptake among females aged 21-39, using assumptions of 85% and 70% reduction in cervical cancer risk from HPV vaccination and up-to-date screening, respectively.
analysis.main_results: Of the surveyed females, 78.4% were up-to-date with screening, 38.0% reported ever receiving an HPV vaccine, and 15.3% were both unvaccinated and not up-to-date with screening. Across age groups, vaccinated females had higher screening rates compared to unvaccinated females, and the relative reduction in cervical cancer risk from vaccination and screening varied by age group.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that despite lower screening rates among younger females, their cervical cancer risk reduction was not the lowest due to higher vaccination levels, highlighting the importance of considering vaccination status in national surveillance data.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that including vaccination status in national surveillance data sets could help identify and target interventions within communities at higher risk, thereby improving population-level protection against cervical cancer.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's reliance on self-reported data and the absence of direct evidence of HPV infection or cervical cancer incidence limit the strength of the evidence, and the findings should be interpreted cautiously.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the impact of HPV vaccination status on cervical screening uptake and cervical cancer risk among females aged 21-39. It found that vaccinated females had higher screening rates and a higher reduction in cervical cancer risk, emphasizing the need to include vaccination status in national surveillance data.

elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study used data from the 2019 National Health Interview Survey, involving 4000 females aged 21-39, to stratify cervical screening uptake by age and HPV vaccination status.
elements_en.methods: The authors analyzed self-reported HPV vaccination status and cervical screening uptake among females aged 21-39, using assumptions of 85% and 70% reduction in cervical cancer risk from HPV vaccination and up-to-date screening, respectively.
elements_en.main_results: Of the surveyed females, 78.4% were up-to-date with screening, 38.0% reported ever receiving an HPV vaccine, and 15.3% were both unvaccinated and not up-to-date with screening. Across age groups, vaccinated females had higher screening rates compared to unvaccinated females, and the relative reduction in cervical cancer risk from vaccination and screening varied by age group.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that despite lower screening rates among younger females, their cervical cancer risk reduction was not the lowest due to higher vaccination levels, highlighting the importance of considering vaccination status in national surveillance data.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that including vaccination status in national surveillance data sets could help identify and target interventions within communities at higher risk, thereby improving population-level protection against cervical cancer.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's reliance on self-reported data and the absence of direct evidence of HPV infection or cervical cancer incidence limit the strength of the evidence, and the findings should be interpreted cautiously.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 HPV 疫苗接种 状态对宫颈筛查的影响和 宫颈癌 风险的影响,解决在评估人群层面针对 宫颈癌 的保护时考虑 疫苗接种 状态的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了 2019 年全国健康访谈调查的数据,涉及 4000 名 21-39 岁的女性,按年龄和 HPV 疫苗接种 状态对宫颈筛查的进行情况进行分层。
elements_zh.methods: 作者分析了 21-39 岁女性自我报告的 HPV 疫苗接种 状态和宫颈筛查情况,假设 HPV 疫苗接种 和最新筛查使 宫颈癌 风险分别降低 85% 和 70%。
elements_zh.main_results: 在接受调查的女性中,78.4% 的女性及时进行了筛查,38.0% 的女性报告曾接受过 HPV 疫苗,15.3% 的女性未接种疫苗且未及时进行筛查。在各个年龄组中,与未接种疫苗的女性相比,接种疫苗的女性具有更高的筛查率,并且 宫颈癌 风险的相对降低因 疫苗接种 和筛查而异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,尽管年轻女性的筛查率较低,但由于 疫苗接种 水平较高,她们的 宫颈癌 风险降低并不是最低的,这凸显了在国家 监测 数据中考虑 疫苗接种 状态的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,将 疫苗接种 状态纳入国家 监测 数据集中可以帮助识别和针对高风险社区内的干预措施,从而提高人群对 宫颈癌 的保护。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究对自我报告数据的依赖以及缺乏 HPV 感染或 宫颈癌 发病率 的直接证据限制了证据的强度,应谨慎解释研究结果。

title_zh: 宫颈癌风险降低在人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种时代的影响。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination status is important to consider when evaluating the population-level impact of cervical screening uptake on cervical cancer risk, yet screening rates are rarely presented by vaccination status, limiting assessments of population-level protection against cervical cancer. METHODS: Using females 21-39 years old from the 2019 National Health Interview Survey (N = 4000), the authors report the proportion up-to-date with cervical screening stratified by age and self-reported HPV vaccination status. Using assumptions of 85% and 70% reduction in cervical cancer risk from HPV vaccination and up-to-date screening status, respectively, the authors explore the population-level reduction in cervical cancer risk from varying screening coverage by HPV vaccination status. RESULTS: A total of 78.4% of females were up-to-date with screening, 38.0% reported ever receiving an HPV vaccine, and 15.3% were both unvaccinated and not up-to-date with screening. Across age groups, the proportion of females up-to-date with screening was 6.3%-19.1% higher for vaccinated versus unvaccinated females. The relative reduction in cervical cancer risk from vaccination and screening ranged from 62.1% for females 36-39 years old to 73.1% for females 26-30 years old, compared to the absence of vaccination and screening. Despite females 21-25 years old having the lowest screening uptake, their reduction in cervical cancer risk was not the lowest due to higher vaccination levels. CONCLUSIONS: Cervical screening rates are higher among females who were vaccinated against HPV, resulting in a higher population-level risk of cervical cancer than expected from considering vaccination and screening rates independently. Including vaccination status in national surveillance data sets would help identify and target interventions within communities at higher risk.
abstract_zh: 背景:在评估宫颈筛查对 宫颈癌 风险的人群水平影响时,需要考虑 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗接种 状态,但 疫苗接种 状态很少显示筛查率,这限制了对 宫颈癌 人群水平保护的评估。方法:作者使用 2019 年全国健康访谈调查 (N = 4000) 中的 21-39 岁女性,报告了按年龄和自我报告的 HPV 疫苗接种 状态分层的最新宫颈筛查比例。假设 HPV 疫苗接种 和最新筛查状态导致的 宫颈癌 风险分别降低 85% 和 70%,作者探索了不同 HPV 疫苗接种 状态筛查覆盖率带来的人群水平 宫颈癌 风险降低情况。结果:共有 78.4% 的女性接受了最新的筛查,38.0% 的女性报告曾接受过 HPV 疫苗,15.3% 的女性未接种疫苗且未接受最新的筛查。在各个年龄组中,接受最新筛查的女性比例,接种疫苗的女性比未接种疫苗的女性高出 6.3%-19.1%。与不进行 疫苗接种 和筛查相比,疫苗接种 和筛查的 宫颈癌 风险相对降低范围为 36-39 岁女性的 62.1% 到 26-30 岁女性的 73.1%。尽管 21-25 岁女性的筛查率最低,但由于 疫苗接种 水平较高,她们的 宫颈癌 风险降低并不是最低的。结论:接种 HPV 疫苗的女性的宫颈筛查率较高,导致 宫颈癌 的人群水平风险高于独立考虑 疫苗接种 和筛查率的预期。将 疫苗接种 状态纳入国家 监测 数据集中将有助于识别和针对高风险社区内的干预措施。

title: Longitudinal viral load trajectories predict cervical lesion risk in women with persistent human papillomavirus infection: A prospective cohort study
abstract: Abstract Background Persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is central to cervical lesion development, but single viral‐load measurements may not capture heterogeneous viral dynamics. This study characterized longitudinal viral‐load trajectories among women with persistent infection and evaluated their associations with cervical lesions and incremental predictive value beyond baseline factors. Methods In this prospective cohort of 1502 HPV‐positive women followed at approximately 6‐month intervals, latent class growth analysis using actual follow‐up time was conducted among 624 women with type‐specific persistent infection. Associations between trajectory group and any cervical lesion (low‐grade squamous intraepithelial lesion or high‐grade squamous intraepithelial lesion [HSIL]) were assessed using multivariable logistic regression; HSIL was explored using Firth‐penalized regression. Discrimination, calibration, and decision‐curve analysis were used to assess incremental predictive performance. Results Of 1170 women with classifiable outcomes, 624 had persistent infection. Four trajectories were identified: low stable (39.6%), moderate declining (18.9%), moderate increasing (29.8%), and persistently high (11.7%). Any‐lesion prevalence was 10.9%, 17.8%, 74.2%, and 90.4%, respectively (p < .001). Compared with the low‐stable group, fully adjusted odds ratios (ORs) were 1.95 (95% CI, 1.02–3.74), 29.66 (95% CI, 16.75–52.51), and 124.29 (95% CI, 47.30–326.60) for the other groups, respectively. The persistently high group was also associated with HSIL (OR, 9.47; 95% CI, 3.18–33.09). The optimism‐corrected area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) increased from 0.713 for the base model to 0.888 for both the simple longitudinal and trajectory models and 0.899 for the joint model. Conclusions Longitudinal HPV viral‐load dynamics identified clinically distinct risk phenotypes. Moderate‐increasing and persistently high trajectories were strongly associated with cervical lesions, whereas longitudinal information improved discrimination beyond baseline measurements. External validation is required before clinical implementation.

This study characterized longitudinal viral-load trajectories among women with persistent infection and evaluated their associations with cervical lesions and incremental predictive value beyond baseline factors. METHODS: In this prospective cohort of 1502 HPV-positive women followed at approximately 6-month intervals, latent class growth analysis using actual follow-up time was conducted among 624 women with type-specific persistent infection. Associations between trajectory group and any cervical lesion (low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion or high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion [HSIL]) were assessed using multivariable logistic regression; HSIL was explored using Firth-penalized regression. Discrimination, calibration, and decision-curve analysis were used to assess incremental predictive performance. RESULTS: Of 1170 women with classifiable outcomes, 624 had persistent infection. Four trajectories were identified: low stable (39.6%), moderate declining (18.9%), moderate increasing (29.8%), and persistently high (11.7%). Any-lesion prevalence was 10.9%, 17.8%, 74.2%, and 90.4%, respectively (p < .001). Compared with the low-stable group, fully adjusted odds ratios (ORs) were 1.95 (95% CI, 1.02-3.74), 29.66 (95% CI, 16.75-52.51), and 124.29 (95% CI, 47.30-326.60) for the other groups, respectively. The persistently high group was also associated with HSIL (OR, 9.47; 95% CI, 3.18-33.09). The optimism-corrected area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) increased from 0.713 for the base model to 0.888 for both the simple longitudinal and trajectory models and 0.899 for the joint model. CONCLUSIONS: Longitudinal HPV viral-load dynamics identified clinically distinct risk phenotypes. Moderate-increasing and persistently high trajectories were strongly associated with cervical lesions, whereas longitudinal information improved discrimination beyond baseline measurements. External validation is required before clinical implementation.

This study characterized longitudinal viral‐load trajectories among women with persistent infection and evaluated their associations with cervical lesions and incremental predictive value beyond baseline factors. Methods In this prospective cohort of 1502 HPV‐positive women followed at approximately 6‐month intervals, latent class growth analysis using actual follow‐up time was conducted among 624 women with type‐specific persistent infection. Associations between trajectory group and any cervical lesion (low‐grade squamous intraepithelial lesion or high‐grade squamous intraepithelial lesion [HSIL]) were assessed using multivariable logistic regression; HSIL was explored using Firth‐penalized regression. Discrimination, calibration, and decision‐curve analysis were used to assess incremental predictive performance. Results Of 1170 women with classifiable outcomes, 624 had persistent infection. Four trajectories were identified: low stable (39.6%), moderate declining (18.9%), moderate increasing (29.8%), and persistently high (11.7%). Any‐lesion prevalence was 10.9%, 17.8%, 74.2%, and 90.4%, respectively (p < .001). Compared with the low‐stable group, fully adjusted odds ratios (ORs) were 1.95 (95% CI, 1.02–3.74), 29.66 (95% CI, 16.75–52.51), and 124.29 (95% CI, 47.30–326.60) for the other groups, respectively. The persistently high group was also associated with HSIL (OR, 9.47; 95% CI, 3.18–33.09). The optimism‐corrected area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) increased from 0.713 for the base model to 0.888 for both the simple longitudinal and trajectory models and 0.899 for the joint model. Conclusions Longitudinal HPV viral‐load dynamics identified clinically distinct risk phenotypes. Moderate‐increasing and persistently high trajectories were strongly associated with cervical lesions, whereas longitudinal information improved discrimination beyond baseline measurements. External validation is required before clinical implementation.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解纵向病毒载量轨迹在预测持续性 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染女性宫颈病变风险中的作用,解决单一病毒载量测量可能无法捕获异质病毒动态的局限性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究在 1502 名 HPV 阳性女性中进行,其中 624 名女性患有特定类型的持续感染,每隔大约 6 个月进行一次随访。
analysis_zh.methods: 潜在类别增长分析用于确定持续感染女性中的病毒载量轨迹,并使用多变量逻辑回归和 Firth 惩罚回归评估与宫颈病变的关联。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究得出的结论是,纵向 HPV 病毒载量动态确定了临床上不同的风险表型,其中中度增加和持续高的轨迹与宫颈病变密切相关,从而改善了基线测量之外的辨别力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,纵向病毒载量信息可以改善宫颈病变风险的预测,从而为 监测、诊断 和 治疗 策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括在临床实施之前需要进行外部验证,以及依赖具有特定纳入标准的前瞻性 队列研究。

title: Inactivation of the RB1 and PTPN14 tumor suppressors cooperatively enables the lifespan extension activity of the human papillomavirus E7 oncoprotein
abstract: High-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) E7 proteins bind and inactivate host cellular tumor suppressors and are essential for the immortalization of primary human keratinocytes. E7 proteins from high- and low-risk HPV genotypes bind directly to at least two tumor suppressors, RB1 and PTPN14, and inactivate both. We previously characterized mutations in high-risk HPV E7 proteins that selectively abrogate the ability of E7 to bind either RB1 or PTPN14. Here, we established a genetic complementation system using the E7 mutants defective for binding to RB1 or PTPN14. Neither mutant alone could extend the lifespan of primary keratinocytes. When expressed together, the mutants could, like wild-type high-risk HPV E7, extend keratinocyte lifespan. Both high- and low-risk E7 reduced PTPN14 protein levels and reduced expression of keratinocyte differentiation genes, whereas only high-risk E7 reduced steady-state RB1 levels and induced E2F-dependent genes. Depletion of either RB1 or PTPN14 could cooperate with low-risk HPV6 E7 to extend keratinocyte lifespan. Our findings advance the model that inactivation of at least two tumor suppressors is required for the lifespan extension activity of high-risk HPV E7.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the cooperative inactivation of RB1 and PTPN14 by high-risk HPV E7 proteins, which are essential for the immortalization of primary human keratinocytes. The research addressed the gap in understanding how these proteins enable the lifespan extension activity of E7.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a genetic complementation system with E7 mutants defective for binding to RB1 or PTPN14, expressed in primary human keratinocytes.
analysis.methods: E7 mutants were established and expressed in keratinocytes to assess their ability to extend cell lifespan. Assays were used to measure the inactivation of RB1 and PTPN14, and the effects on keratinocyte differentiation genes.
analysis.main_results: Neither mutant alone could extend keratinocyte lifespan, but when expressed together, they cooperatively extended the lifespan of primary keratinocytes. title_zh: RB1 和 PTPN14 肿瘤抑制因子的失活协同作用使 人乳头瘤病毒 E7 癌蛋白的寿命延长
source_body_en: High-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) E7 proteins bind and inactivate host cellular tumor suppressors and are essential for the immortalization of primary human keratinocytes. E7 proteins from high- and low-risk HPV genotypes bind directly to at least two tumor suppressors, RB1 and PTPN14, and inactivate both. We previously characterized mutations in high-risk HPV E7 proteins that selectively abrogate the ability of E7 to bind either RB1 or PTPN14. Here, we established a genetic complementation system using the E7 mutants defective for binding to RB1 or PTPN14. Neither mutant alone could extend the lifespan of primary keratinocytes. When expressed together, the mutants could, like wild-type high-risk HPV E7, extend keratinocyte lifespan. Both high- and low-risk E7 reduced PTPN14 protein levels and reduced expression of keratinocyte differentiation genes, whereas only high-risk E7 reduced steady-state RB1 levels and induced E2F-dependent genes. Depletion of either RB1 or PTPN14 could cooperate with low-risk HPV6 E7 to extend keratinocyte lifespan. Our findings advance the model that inactivation of at least two tumor suppressors is required for the lifespan extension activity of high-risk HPV E7.

title: TP53 sequencing and high-risk HPV status in 30 vulvar squamous cell carcinomas with rare combinations of p16 and p53 expression patterns.
abstract: Most vulvar squamous cell carcinomas (VSCCs) are classified using p16 and p53 immunohistochemistry into so-called human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated (p16-positive) or HPV-independent tumors (typically p16-negative) with wild-type or mutant p53 expression. However, a rare subset of VSCCs demonstrates unusual p16/p53 staining patterns, challenging their classification. Here, we report 30 such tumors, representing, to our knowledge, the largest series to date. p53 immunostaining was evaluated using the six-pattern framework, including four mutant patterns (basal overexpression, parabasal/diffuse overexpression, cytoplasmic, and absent) and two wild-type patterns (scattered and mid-epithelial). All cases underwent TP53 next-generation sequencing and high-risk HPV (hrHPV) DNA PCR testing. The largest subgroup consisted of tumors showing p16 positivity and p53 overexpression (n=20). Of these, 18 harbored TP53 mutations, while hrHPV DNA was detected in seven, including the two TP53 wild-type tumors. Six tumors showed p16 positivity with absent p53 staining; all harbored TP53 mutations, and two were also hrHPV DNA positive. Three tumors showed p16 positivity confined to the nuclei with p53 overexpression; all harbored TP53 mutations, and one was hrHPV-positive. The final case was p16-negative with a mid-epithelial p53 staining pattern, known to be strongly associated with HPV-associated tumors. This tumor was TP53 wild-type and hrHPV33-positive. Our study demonstrates that not all VSCCs are readily classified by p16 and p53 immunohistochemistry and confirms that p16 positivity alone is insufficient to define HPV-association. Most tumors showed concurrent p16 positivity (three with nuclear-only staining) and p53 mutant patterns, and molecular analysis supported predominantly TP53-driven carcinogenesis with TP53 mutations detected in 93% (27/29). However, hrHPV DNA was also detected in 10 cases, suggesting more complex biology. This rare subset of VSCCs may therefore be better categorized by their immunophenotypic and molecular profiles rather than forced into the current classification. Further studies with prognostic correlation are needed to clarify their biological and clinical significance.

title_zh: 30 例外阴鳞状细胞癌中的 TP53 测序和 高危型HPV 状态,具有罕见的 p16 和 p53 表达模式组合。
source_body_en: Most vulvar squamous cell carcinomas (VSCCs) are classified using p16 and p53 immunohistochemistry into so-called human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated (p16-positive) or HPV-independent tumors (typically p16-negative) with wild-type or mutant p53 expression. However, a rare subset of VSCCs demonstrates unusual p16/p53 staining patterns, challenging their classification. Here, we report 30 such tumors, representing, to our knowledge, the largest series to date. p53 immunostaining was evaluated using the six-pattern framework, including four mutant patterns (basal overexpression, parabasal/diffuse overexpression, cytoplasmic, and absent) and two wild-type patterns (scattered and mid-epithelial). All cases underwent TP53 next-generation sequencing and high-risk HPV (hrHPV) DNA PCR testing. The largest subgroup consisted of tumors showing p16 positivity and p53 overexpression (n=20). Of these, 18 harbored TP53 mutations, while hrHPV DNA was detected in seven, including the two TP53 wild-type tumors. Six tumors showed p16 positivity with absent p53 staining; all harbored TP53 mutations, and two were also hrHPV DNA positive. Three tumors showed p16 positivity confined to the nuclei with p53 overexpression; all harbored TP53 mutations, and one was hrHPV-positive. The final case was p16-negative with a mid-epithelial p53 staining pattern, known to be strongly associated with HPV-associated tumors. This tumor was TP53 wild-type and hrHPV33-positive. Our study demonstrates that not all VSCCs are readily classified by p16 and p53 immunohistochemistry and confirms that p16 positivity alone is insufficient to define HPV-association. Most tumors showed concurrent p16 positivity (three with nuclear-only staining) and p53 mutant patterns, and molecular analysis supported predominantly TP53-driven carcinogenesis with TP53 mutations detected in 93% (27/29). However, hrHPV DNA was also detected in 10 cases, suggesting more complex biology. This rare subset of VSCCs may therefore be better categorized by their immunophenotypic and molecular profiles rather than forced into the current classification. Further studies with prognostic correlation are needed to clarify their biological and clinical significance.

title: Study on the molecular mechanism of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells inducing epithelial-mesenchymal transition in HPV-associated cervical cancer through activation of miR-129.
abstract: BACKGROUND: HPV-associated cervical cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related death in women worldwide. The role of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) and miR-129 in tumor progression remains unclear. OBJECTIVES: To investigate miR-129 expression and its clinical significance in HPV-associated cervical cancer and to explore whether BMSCs regulate malignant phenotypes through miR-129. METHODS: miR-129 expression was measured by qRT-PCR in 77 cervical cancer and 30 normal cervical tissues. Associations with clinicopathological features and overall survival (OS) were analyzed. Diagnostic value was assessed by ROC curve. Rat BMSCs were co-cultured with SiHa and HeLa cells. Following miR-129 overexpression or knockdown, cell proliferation (CCK-8, colony formation), invasion (Transwell) and expression of E-cadherin, N-cadherin and MRP1 (Western blot) were examined. RESULTS: miR-129 expression was significantly higher in cervical cancer tissues than in normal controls (3.24±0.56 vs. High miR-129 expression correlated with tumor size ≥3 cm (P=0.009), FIGO stage III-IV (P=0.0034) and lymph node metastasis (P=0.038). High expression was associated with shorter OS (median: 28.4 vs. 46.2 months; HR=2.944, 95%CI:1.484-5.842, P=0.002). The AUC was 0.788 (95%CI:0.693-0.884), with a cut-off of 1.85 (sensitivity:76.9%, specificity:70.4%). BMSC co-culture upregulated miR-129 expression (SiHa: 3.52±0.42 vs. miR-129 overexpression promoted proliferation, colony formation and invasion, while knockdown suppressed these phenotypes. Overexpression of miR-129 reduced E-cadherin (0.42±0.05 vs. 1.00±0.08, P<0.01) and increased N-cadherin (2.85±0.22 vs. 1.00±0.10, P<0.01) and MRP1 (2.46±0.18 vs. Knockdown of miR-129 partially reversed BMSC-induced changes in these proteins. CONCLUSION: miR-129 is significantly upregulated in HPV-associated cervical cancer and shows potential as a diagnostic and prognostic biomarker. BMSCs upregulate miR-129 in cervical cancer cells and miR-129 modulates proliferation, invasion, EMT marker expression and MRP1 expression. These findings suggest that the BMSCs/miR-129 axis may contribute to cervical cancer progression, but further in-vivo and mechanistic studies are needed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨 miR-129 在 HPV 相关 宫颈癌 中的作用,解决骨髓间充质干细胞 (BMSC) 和 miR-129 在肿瘤进展中之间尚不清楚的关系。HPV 相关的 宫颈癌 仍然是全球女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因。

elements_zh.methods: 通过 qRT-PCR 测量 miR-129 表达,并分析与临床病理特征和总生存期的关联。通过ROC曲线评估诊断价值,并将BMSC与SiHa和HeLa细胞共培养以检查miR-129过表达或敲低效应。
elements_zh.main_results: 与正常对照相比,宫颈癌 组织中 miR-129 的表达显着较高。miR-129 高表达与肿瘤大小、FIGO 分期和淋巴结转移相关,并且与较短的总生存期相关。BMSC 共培养上调 miR-129 表达,促进增殖、集落形成和侵袭,而 miR-129 过表达降低 E-钙粘蛋白并增加 N-钙粘蛋白和 MRP1 表达。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,BMSCs/miR-129 轴可能有助于 宫颈癌 的进展,但还需要进一步的体内和机制研究。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究将 miR-129 确定为 HPV 相关 宫颈癌 的潜在诊断和预后生物标志物,并强调了 BMSC 在调节 miR-129 表达和癌细胞表型中的作用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到体外模型的使用和进一步体内验证的需要的限制。样本量相对较小,研究结果的普遍性可能有限。

title: Detection of High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Using the cobas® 4800 System among Women Screened for Cervical Cancer in Western Province, Zambia: A Retrospective Laboratory-Based Study
abstract: Background: High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection is the cause of cervical cancer, but its distribution varies across populations and geographical settings. Evidence on HR-HPV infection across districts of Western Province, Zambia, remains limited. This study determined the prevalence and distribution of HR-HPV infection and examined variation by age and district among women screened for cervical cancer. Methods: We conducted a retrospective laboratory-based cross-sectional study using routinely collected cervical cancer screening records from women tested for HR-HPV between 9 May 2025 and 29 June 2026. Data were extracted from the laboratory information system of the Kaoma PCR Laboratory, which serves seven districts in Western Province. HR-HPV testing was performed using the cobas® 4800 HPV Test. The primary outcome was detection of at least one HR-HPV target. HR-HPV prevalence and target distribution were summarized using proportions with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Differences across age groups and districts were assessed using Pearson's chi-square test. Logistic regression was used to estimate crude and adjusted odds ratios (aORs) with 95% CIs for factors associated with HR-HPV positivity. Results: Among 1,623 women, the median age was 40 years (IQR 31–49; range 15–89). HR-HPV was detected in 529 women, giving an overall prevalence of 32.59% (95% CI 30.35–34.92). Prevalence was highest among women aged <25 years (46.58%) and decreased to 26.67% among those aged 45–54 years before increasing to 34.32% among those aged 55–64 years (χ2=26.96, p<0.001). HR-HPV prevalence ranged from 21.84% in Kalabo to 37.04% in Nkeyema (χ2=12.70, p=0.048). Among HR-HPV-positive women, 456 (86.20%) had other HR-HPV targets, 88 (16.64%) had HPV16, and 48 (9.07%) had HPV18/45. Compared with women aged <25 years, adjusted odds of HR-HPV positivity were lower among those aged 25–34 years (aOR 0.66, 95% CI 0.45–0.97), 35–44 years (0.43, 0.29–0.64), 45–54 years (0.38, 0.25–0.57), 55–64 years (0.55, 0.35–0.88), and ≥65 years (0.50, 0.26–0.97). Women from Kalabo had lower odds of HR-HPV positivity than those from Kaoma (aOR 0.55, 95% CI 0.37–0.83). Conclusions: HR-HPV infection affected approximately one-third of women screened across seven districts of Western Province, with substantial variation by age and district. The predominance of other HR-HPV targets highlights the importance of broad HR-HPV detection in cervical cancer screening. District-level surveillance using routinely generated laboratory data can provide useful evidence for monitoring and strengthening cervical cancer prevention services in Western Province.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to determine the prevalence and distribution of high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection among women screened for cervical cancer in Western Province, Zambia, addressing the limited evidence on HR-HPV infection across districts in the region.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A retrospective laboratory-based cross-sectional study was conducted using cervical cancer screening records from women tested for HR-HPV between May 9, 2025, and June 29, 2026, in seven districts of Western Province, Zambia.
analysis_en.methods: HR-HPV testing was performed using the cobas® 4800 HPV Test, and data were extracted from the laboratory information system of the Kaoma PCR Laboratory. Prevalence was summarized using proportions with 95% confidence intervals, and differences across age groups and districts were assessed using statistical tests.
analysis_en.main_results: Among 1,623 women, the overall prevalence of HR-HPV was 32.59% (95% CI 30.35–34.92). Prevalence varied by age, with the highest rates among women aged <25 years, and by district, with the highest in Nkeyema and lowest in Kalabo.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that HR-HPV infection affected approximately one-third of women screened across seven districts of Western Province, with substantial variation by age and district. The predominance of other HR-HPV targets highlights the importance of broad HR-HPV detection in cervical cancer screening.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: District-level surveillance using routinely generated laboratory data can provide useful evidence for monitoring and strengthening cervical cancer prevention services in Western Province.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and reliance on routinely collected data, which may introduce bias. The sample size and geographical coverage are adequate for the study objectives, but the evidence strength is moderate due to these limitations.

title_zh: 使用 cobas® 4800 系统在赞比亚西部省筛查 宫颈癌 的女性中检测高风险 人乳头瘤病毒:基于实验室的回顾性研究
source_body_en: Background: High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection is the cause of cervical cancer, but its distribution varies across populations and geographical settings. Evidence on HR-HPV infection across districts of Western Province, Zambia, remains limited. This study determined the prevalence and distribution of HR-HPV infection and examined variation by age and district among women screened for cervical cancer. Methods: We conducted a retrospective laboratory-based cross-sectional study using routinely collected cervical cancer screening records from women tested for HR-HPV between 9 May 2025 and 29 June 2026. Data were extracted from the laboratory information system of the Kaoma PCR Laboratory, which serves seven districts in Western Province. HR-HPV testing was performed using the cobas® 4800 HPV Test. The primary outcome was detection of at least one HR-HPV target. HR-HPV prevalence and target distribution were summarized using proportions with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Differences across age groups and districts were assessed using Pearson's chi-square test. Logistic regression was used to estimate crude and adjusted odds ratios (aORs) with 95% CIs for factors associated with HR-HPV positivity. Results: Among 1,623 women, the median age was 40 years (IQR 31–49; range 15–89). HR-HPV was detected in 529 women, giving an overall prevalence of 32.59% (95% CI 30.35–34.92). Prevalence was highest among women aged <25 years (46.58%) and decreased to 26.67% among those aged 45–54 years before increasing to 34.32% among those aged 55–64 years (χ2=26.96, p<0.001). HR-HPV prevalence ranged from 21.84% in Kalabo to 37.04% in Nkeyema (χ2=12.70, p=0.048). Among HR-HPV-positive women, 456 (86.20%) had other HR-HPV targets, 88 (16.64%) had HPV16, and 48 (9.07%) had HPV18/45. Compared with women aged <25 years, adjusted odds of HR-HPV positivity were lower among those aged 25–34 years (aOR 0.66, 95% CI 0.45–0.97), 35–44 years (0.43, 0.29–0.64), 45–54 years (0.38, 0.25–0.57), 55–64 years (0.55, 0.35–0.88), and ≥65 years (0.50, 0.26–0.97). Women from Kalabo had lower odds of HR-HPV positivity than those from Kaoma (aOR 0.55, 95% CI 0.37–0.83). Conclusions: HR-HPV infection affected approximately one-third of women screened across seven districts of Western Province, with substantial variation by age and district. The predominance of other HR-HPV targets highlights the importance of broad HR-HPV detection in cervical cancer screening. District-level surveillance using routinely generated laboratory data can provide useful evidence for monitoring and strengthening cervical cancer prevention services in Western Province.

title: Epidemiological Characteristics of HPV Infection and Vaccination Coverage in Outpatient Population of a Suburban Chinese Hospital: A 7-Year Real-World Retrospective Analysis (2018–2024)
abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines can effectively prevent cervical cancer; however, HPV vaccine implementation in China lags nearly a decade behind many countries. Rural areas face particularly low cervical cancer screening rates and even more limited vaccine uptake. As vaccination coverage increases among the predominantly adult female population, the prevalence and genotype distribution of HPV are expected to shift. This study aimed to provide real-world evidence on vaccination coverage and its relationship with HPV infection patterns in a resource-limited suburban Chinese population. Methods: This retrospective study analyzed outpatient HPV testing data from a suburban county hospital in China from 2018 to 2024. Vaccination histories were verified through the national immunization information system, supplemented by on-site questionnaire surveys. HPV genotyping was performed for 21 HPV types. Age-stratified analyses (≤45 and ≥46 years) were conducted to evaluate genotype-specific trends, and odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated to assess vaccine protective effects. Results: Among 19,057 eligible outpatient females aged ≤45 years, the HPV vaccination rate increased from 0.34% in 2018 to 57.47% in 2024 (χ2 = 4986.046, p < 0.001), with a full-course vaccination rate of 93.38%. Nine-valent vaccine-type HPV positivity decreased from 10.95% in 2018 to 6.72% in 2024 (relative reduction 38.7%, 95% CI 18.5–53.8), and non-vaccine-type positivity decreased from 13.38% to 6.21% (relative reduction 53.6%, 95% CI 40.1–64.1); the larger decline in non-vaccine types suggests that temporal changes in the tested population also contribute to these trends. Among females aged ≤45 years, vaccine-covered types (HPV-16, -33, -45, -52, -58) and non-vaccine types (HPV-39, -53, -73, -51, -56, -59, -68) showed significant declining trends (p < 0.05). Vaccinated females had significantly lower positivity rates for HPV-6, -11, -16, -33, -52, and -45 compared with unvaccinated females (OR range: 0.333–0.838), with smaller reductions for HPV-18 and for the non-vaccine types HPV-73, -39, and -59 that warrant further investigation. The predominant high-risk types among unvaccinated females were HPV-52 (3.36%), HPV-16 (2.32%), and HPV-58 (1.90%). Conclusions: HPV vaccination coverage among outpatient females increased substantially from 2018 to 2024, accompanied by declines in positivity for vaccine and non-vaccine types; because non-vaccine-type positivity also fell substantially, these ecological trends cannot be attributed to vaccination alone. After adjustment for age and calendar year, vaccination remained associated with lower positivity for vaccine-covered genotypes, whereas no association was observed for non-vaccine types; the findings for individual non-vaccine genotypes therefore do not provide evidence of cross-protection. High-prevalence genotypes including HPV-53, -39, -51, -66, -68, and -56 remain uncovered by current vaccines, highlighting the need for next-generation higher-valency vaccines that address locally prevalent genotypes.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 农村地区的 宫颈癌 筛查率特别低,疫苗 的使用率甚至更有限。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项回顾性研究分析了2018年至2024年中国郊区县医院门诊HPV检测数据。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 九价疫苗型HPV阳性率从2018年的10.95%下降到2024年的6.72%(相对下降38.7%,95% CI 18.5–53.8),非疫苗型HPV阳性率从13.38%下降到6.21%(相对下降) 53.6%,95% CI 40.1–64.1);非 疫苗 类型的大幅下降表明,测试人群的时间变化也促成了这些趋势。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本研究旨在为资源有限的中国郊区人口中 疫苗接种 覆盖率及其与 HPV 感染模式的关系提供真实世界的证据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 调整年龄和日历年份后,疫苗接种 仍然与 疫苗 覆盖的基因型的较低阳性率相关,而对于非 疫苗 类型则没有观察到相关性;因此,个体非 疫苗 基因型的研究结果并未提供交叉保护的证据。

abstract_zh: 背景:人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗可以有效预防宫颈癌;然而,HPV 疫苗 在中国的实施比许多国家落后了近十年。农村地区的 宫颈癌 筛查率特别低,疫苗 的使用率甚至更有限。随着 疫苗接种 在以成年女性为主的人群中覆盖率的增加,HPV 的 患病率 和基因型分布预计会发生变化。本研究旨在为资源有限的中国郊区人口中 疫苗接种 覆盖率及其与 HPV 感染模式的关系提供真实世界的证据。方法:本回顾性研究分析了2018年至2024年中国郊区县医院门诊HPV检测数据。通过国家免疫信息系统核实疫苗接种历史,并辅以现场问卷调查。对 21 种 HPV 类型进行了 HPV 基因分型。进行年龄分层分析(≤45 岁和≥46 岁)以评估基因型特异性趋势,并计算优势比(OR)和 95% 置信区间(CI)以评估 疫苗 的保护作用。结果:在19,057名年龄≤45岁的合格门诊女性中,HPV 疫苗接种率从2018年的0.34%上升至2024年的57.47%(χ2 = 4986.046,p < 0.001),全程疫苗接种率为93.38%。九价疫苗型HPV阳性率从2018年的10.95%下降到2024年的6.72%(相对下降38.7%,95% CI 18.5–53.8),非疫苗型HPV阳性率从13.38%下降到6.21%(相对下降) 53.6%,95% CI 40.1–64.1);非 疫苗 类型的大幅下降表明,测试人群的时间变化也促成了这些趋势。在年龄≤45岁的女性中,疫苗覆盖型(HPV-16、-33、-45、-52、-58)和非疫苗型(HPV-39、-53、-73、-51、-56、-59、-68)呈现显着下降趋势(p < 0.05)。与未接种疫苗的女性相比,接种疫苗的女性 HPV-6、-11、-16、-33、-52 和 -45 的阳性率显着降低(OR 范围:0.333–0.838),HPV-18 和非 疫苗 型 HPV-73、-39 和 -59 的降低幅度较小,值得进一步研究。未接种疫苗的女性中,主要的高危类型是HPV-52(3.36%)、HPV-16(2.32%)和HPV-58(1.90%)。结论:从 2018 年到 2024 年,门诊女性中 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率大幅增加,同时 疫苗 和非 疫苗 型的阳性率下降;由于非疫苗型积极性也大幅下降,这些生态趋势不能单独归因于疫苗接种。调整年龄和日历年份后,疫苗接种 仍然与 疫苗 覆盖的基因型的较低阳性率相关,而对于非 疫苗 类型则没有观察到相关性;因此,个体非 疫苗 基因型的研究结果并未提供交叉保护的证据。目前的 疫苗 仍未发现包括 HPV-53、-39、-51、-66、-68 和 -56 在内的高 患病率 基因型,这凸显了对解决当地流行基因型的下一代更高价 疫苗 的需求。

title: Evaluation of Immune Responses Induced by Oral Administration of Human Papillomavirus 16 E2-Expressing Lactobacillus in a Mouse Model
abstract: Background/Objectives: Persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection increases cervical cancer risk, yet no established treatment eradicates persistent infection. We developed LacE2N, an oral vaccine formulation derived from recombinant Lacticaseibacillus paracasei expressing the HPV16 E2 N-terminal domain, and evaluated murine immunogenicity and E2 transcription in human cervical specimens. Methods: Candidate E2 peptides were identified by MHC class I-binding prediction and IFN-γ ELISpot screening. Recombinant bacterial E2N expression was assessed by colony blotting and flow cytometry. Following oral immunization, splenocyte and intestinal intraepithelial lymphocyte (IEL) responses were evaluated by ELISpot. Differential cytotoxicity against TC-1/E2 versus parental TC-1 cells was measured by LDH release. Cervical E2 transcripts were assessed by RT-qPCR. Results: Peptide 8 (amino acids 71–85) was selected as a candidate immunogenic region. Colony blotting and flow cytometry supported bacterial E2N expression. In an exploratory IEL comparison (one mouse/group), responses were higher with 5 mg LacE2N than PBS. LacE2N (1 mg) yielded higher IEL and splenocyte IFN-γ responses than Lac controls. Splenic responses were numerically higher with 2 mg than 1 mg LacE2N or Lac. High-dose immunization enhanced differential cytotoxicity against TC-1/E2 at effector-to-target ratios of 5:1 and 10:1. E2 N-terminal transcripts were detected in all 68 HPV16-positive cervical specimens, including seven without histologically detectable cervical intraepithelial neoplasia. Conclusions: These findings provide a preclinical rationale for further investigation of E2-targeted oral vaccination against persistent HPV16 infection, particularly before the development of established precancerous lesions. Further studies are warranted to establish antigen-specific immune mechanisms and therapeutic efficacy.

title_zh: 在小鼠模型中口服表达 人乳头瘤病毒 16 E2 的乳杆菌诱导 免疫应答 的评价
source_body_en: Background/Objectives: Persistent human papillomavirus (HPV) infection increases cervical cancer risk, yet no established treatment eradicates persistent infection. We developed LacE2N, an oral vaccine formulation derived from recombinant Lacticaseibacillus paracasei expressing the HPV16 E2 N-terminal domain, and evaluated murine immunogenicity and E2 transcription in human cervical specimens. Methods: Candidate E2 peptides were identified by MHC class I-binding prediction and IFN-γ ELISpot screening. Recombinant bacterial E2N expression was assessed by colony blotting and flow cytometry. Following oral immunization, splenocyte and intestinal intraepithelial lymphocyte (IEL) responses were evaluated by ELISpot. Differential cytotoxicity against TC-1/E2 versus parental TC-1 cells was measured by LDH release. Cervical E2 transcripts were assessed by RT-qPCR. Results: Peptide 8 (amino acids 71–85) was selected as a candidate immunogenic region. Colony blotting and flow cytometry supported bacterial E2N expression. In an exploratory IEL comparison (one mouse/group), responses were higher with 5 mg LacE2N than PBS. LacE2N (1 mg) yielded higher IEL and splenocyte IFN-γ responses than Lac controls. Splenic responses were numerically higher with 2 mg than 1 mg LacE2N or Lac. High-dose immunization enhanced differential cytotoxicity against TC-1/E2 at effector-to-target ratios of 5:1 and 10:1. E2 N-terminal transcripts were detected in all 68 HPV16-positive cervical specimens, including seven without histologically detectable cervical intraepithelial neoplasia. Conclusions: These findings provide a preclinical rationale for further investigation of E2-targeted oral vaccination against persistent HPV16 infection, particularly before the development of established precancerous lesions. Further studies are warranted to establish antigen-specific immune mechanisms and therapeutic efficacy.
abstract_zh: 背景/目标:持续性 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染会增加 宫颈癌 风险,但尚无既定的 治疗 能够根除持续性感染。我们开发了 LacE2N,一种口服 疫苗 制剂,源自表达 HPV16 E2 N 末端结构域的重组副干酪乳杆菌,并评估了鼠免疫原性和人宫颈标本中的 E2 转录。方法:通过 MHC I 类结合预测和 IFN-γ ELISpot 筛选来鉴定候选 E2 肽。通过菌落印迹和流式细胞术评估重组细菌 E2N 表达。口服免疫后,通过 ELISpot 评估脾细胞和肠上皮内淋巴细胞 (IEL) 反应。通过 LDH 释放来测量针对 TC-1/E2 与亲代 TC-1 细胞的差异细胞毒性。通过 RT-qPCR 评估宫颈 E2 转录本。结果:肽 8(氨基酸 71-85)被选为候选免疫原性区域。菌落印迹和流式细胞术支持细菌 E2N 表达。在一项探索性 IEL 比较(一只小鼠/组)中,5 mg LacE2N 的反应高于 PBS。LacE2N (1 mg) 比 Lac 对照产生更高的 IEL 和脾细胞 IFN-γ 反应。2 mg LacE2N 或 Lac 的脾脏反应在数值上高于 1 mg LacE2N 或 Lac。高剂量免疫增强了针对 TC-1/E2 的差异细胞毒性,效应子与靶标的比例为 5:1 和 10:1。在所有 68 份 HPV16 阳性宫颈标本中均检测到 E2 N 末端转录本,其中 7 份没有组织学可检测到的宫颈上皮内瘤变。结论:这些发现为进一步研究 E2 靶向口服 疫苗接种 针对持续 HPV16 感染的作用提供了临床前依据,特别是在已形成的癌前病变发生之前。需要进一步的研究来建立抗原特异性免疫机制和治疗功效。

title: Erectile function and health-related quality of life in men with genital warts: a comparative cross-sectional study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Genital warts are associated with psychosocial and sexual health concerns. However, comparative evidence regarding erectile function and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in affected men remains limited. OBJECTIVE: To compare erectile function, the proportion with IIEF-5-defined erectile dysfunction (ED), and HRQoL between men with and without genital warts, and to examine associations between erectile function and HRQoL. METHODS: This comparative cross-sectional study included 65 men with clinically diagnosed genital warts and 65 control participants without genital warts. Erectile function and HRQoL were assessed using the IIEF-5 and 12-Item Short Form Health Survey (SF-12), respectively. Between-group comparisons used the Mann-Whitney U test. Age-category-adjusted prevalence ratios were estimated using modified Poisson regression. Correlations were assessed using Spearman's coefficient, with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction applied separately to outcome comparisons and correlation tests. RESULTS: Median IIEF-5 scores were 21 in the genital warts group and 24 in controls (p < 0.001; Hodges-Lehmann location shift, - 2.0 points; 95% CI, - 3.0 to - 1.0). IIEF-5-defined ED occurred in 33/65 (50.8%) and 13/65 (20.0%) participants, respectively (age-category-adjusted prevalence ratio, 2.54; 95% CI, 1.53-4.19). The PCS-12 between-group difference was small (Hodges-Lehmann location shift, - 0.66 points; p = 0.023; FDR-adjusted q = 0.035), while MCS-12 scores did not differ significantly (p = 0.110). IIEF-5 correlated positively with PCS-12 in the overall sample (ρ = 0.39), genital warts group (ρ = 0.29), and controls (ρ = 0.44), but not with MCS-12. CONCLUSIONS: Men with genital warts had lower erectile function scores and a higher proportion with IIEF-5-defined ED than controls. The IIEF-5 score difference was modest, with uncertain clinical relevance, and HRQoL differences were limited. Because of the cross-sectional design and potential residual confounding, causality cannot be established. Prospective studies are warranted.

title_zh: 患有生殖器疣的男性的勃起功能和健康相关的生活质量:一项比较横断面研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Genital warts are associated with psychosocial and sexual health concerns. However, comparative evidence regarding erectile function and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in affected men remains limited. OBJECTIVE: To compare erectile function, the proportion with IIEF-5-defined erectile dysfunction (ED), and HRQoL between men with and without genital warts, and to examine associations between erectile function and HRQoL. METHODS: This comparative cross-sectional study included 65 men with clinically diagnosed genital warts and 65 control participants without genital warts. Erectile function and HRQoL were assessed using the IIEF-5 and 12-Item Short Form Health Survey (SF-12), respectively. Between-group comparisons used the Mann-Whitney U test. Age-category-adjusted prevalence ratios were estimated using modified Poisson regression. Correlations were assessed using Spearman's coefficient, with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction applied separately to outcome comparisons and correlation tests. RESULTS: Median IIEF-5 scores were 21 in the genital warts group and 24 in controls (p < 0.001; Hodges-Lehmann location shift, - 2.0 points; 95% CI, - 3.0 to - 1.0). IIEF-5-defined ED occurred in 33/65 (50.8%) and 13/65 (20.0%) participants, respectively (age-category-adjusted prevalence ratio, 2.54; 95% CI, 1.53-4.19). The PCS-12 between-group difference was small (Hodges-Lehmann location shift, - 0.66 points; p = 0.023; FDR-adjusted q = 0.035), while MCS-12 scores did not differ significantly (p = 0.110). IIEF-5 correlated positively with PCS-12 in the overall sample (ρ = 0.39), genital warts group (ρ = 0.29), and controls (ρ = 0.44), but not with MCS-12. CONCLUSIONS: Men with genital warts had lower erectile function scores and a higher proportion with IIEF-5-defined ED than controls. The IIEF-5 score difference was modest, with uncertain clinical relevance, and HRQoL differences were limited. Because of the cross-sectional design and potential residual confounding, causality cannot be established. Prospective studies are warranted.

title: Wavelet-based study and analysis of human papillomavirus (HPV) through a new mathematical model
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is recognized as the leading cause of cervical cancer, one of the most prevalent malignancies affecting women worldwide. This article presents a compartmental mathematical model that describes the transmission of HPV leading to cervical cancer. The model divides the total population into six compartments: susceptible, exposed, infected, cervical cancer, recovered, and vaccinated. The formulated nonlinear system of differential equations captures the epidemiological transitions among these classes, including infection, progression, recovery, and disease-induced mortality. To obtain an efficient and accurate approximate solution, the Lucas wavelet method (LuWM) is employed. The Lucas wavelet basis functions, possessing orthogonality and compact support, are used to transform the system into a set of algebraic equations. Convergence analyses confirm the reliability of the proposed scheme. The method’s efficiency is demonstrated through numerical simulations and graphical illustrations. The results of various techniques are compared with the proposed LuWM. The variation of different dependent variables with respect to different parameters is discussed using figures. The findings provide valuable insight into HPV dynamics and can assist in designing optimal control strategies for cervical cancer prevention.

title: Impact of Human Papillomavirus Vaccination Coverage on Cytopathological Findings: A Cross-sectional Study in a Tertiary Care Teaching Hospital of Uttar Pradesh
abstract: Background: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary etiological factor in cervical cancer development.Although HPV vaccines provide strong protection, disparities exist between full-dose and incomplete/no vaccination in their impact on cytological outcomes.Objective: To evaluate and compare the prevalence of cervical cytological abnormalities among women who completed the full HPV vaccine schedule and those who received partial or no vaccination.Materials and methods: This hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January 2023 to January 2025 in a tertiary care hospital in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India.A total of 4,200 women aged 25-45 years undergoing cervical cancer screening were included.Participants were categorized based on HPV vaccination status: Full-dose (three-doses) vs partial/no-dose.Pap smears were classified per the Bethesda 2014 system.Demographics, reproductive history, and behavioral risk factors were assessed.Multivariable logistic regression determined adjusted associations.Results: Abnormal Pap smear prevalence was significantly lower in the full-dose group (5.8%) compared to the partial/no-dose group (14.7%) (p < 0.001).Fully vaccinated women had reduced odds of high-grade lesions (HSIL+) [adjusted odds ratio (aOR): 0.23; 95% CI: 0.15-0.36].The protective effect remained consistent across subgroups stratified by age, parity, and sexual debut.Conclusion: Completion of the full HPV vaccine schedule is associated with markedly lower rates of cytological abnormalities.Enhancing vaccine adherence should be a priority for cervical cancer prevention.
journal: Journal of South Asian Federation of Obstetrics and Gynaecology

elements_zh.methods: 高危人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV)的持续感染是宫颈癌发展的主要病因。尽管HPV 疫苗提供了强有力的保护,但全剂量和不完整/无疫苗接种对细胞学结果的影响存在差异。目的:评估和比较完成完整HPV的女性中患病率对宫颈细胞学异常的影响疫苗 时间表以及部分或未接受 疫苗接种 的患者。材料和方法:这项以医院为基础的横断面研究于 2023 年 1 月至 2025 年 1 月在印度北方邦阿格拉的一家三级护理医院进行。总共纳入了 4,200 名年龄在 25-45 岁之间接受 宫颈癌 筛查的女性。参与者根据以下条件进行分类: HPV 疫苗接种 状态:全剂量(三剂量)与部分/无剂量。根据 Bethesda 2014 系统对巴氏涂片进行分类。评估人口统计学、生殖史和行为风险因素。多变量逻辑回归确定调整后的关联。结果:与部分/无剂量组相比,全剂量组中异常子宫颈抹片检查 (5.8%) 显着降低(14.7%) (p < 0.001)。完全接种疫苗的女性出现高级别病变 (HSIL+) 的几率降低[调整后的比值比 (aOR):0.23;95% CI: 0.15-0.36]。按年龄、胎次和初次性行为分层的亚组中,保护作用保持一致。结论:完成完整的 HPV 疫苗 时间表与显着降低的细胞学异常率相关。增强 疫苗 的依从性应成为 宫颈癌 预防的优先事项。

analysis_zh.methods: 高危人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV)的持续感染是宫颈癌发展的主要病因。尽管HPV 疫苗提供了强有力的保护,但全剂量和不完整/无疫苗接种对细胞学结果的影响存在差异。目的:评估和比较完成完整HPV的女性中患病率对宫颈细胞学异常的影响疫苗 时间表以及部分或未接受 疫苗接种 的患者。材料和方法:这项以医院为基础的横断面研究于 2023 年 1 月至 2025 年 1 月在印度北方邦阿格拉的一家三级护理医院进行。总共纳入了 4,200 名年龄在 25-45 岁之间接受 宫颈癌 筛查的女性。参与者根据以下条件进行分类: HPV 疫苗接种 状态:全剂量(三剂量)与部分/无剂量。根据 Bethesda 2014 系统对巴氏涂片进行分类。评估人口统计学、生殖史和行为风险因素。多变量逻辑回归确定调整后的关联。结果:与部分/无剂量组相比,全剂量组中异常子宫颈抹片检查 (5.8%) 显着降低(14.7%) (p < 0.001)。完全接种疫苗的女性出现高级别病变 (HSIL+) 的几率降低[调整后的比值比 (aOR):0.23;95% CI: 0.15-0.36]。按年龄、胎次和初次性行为分层的亚组中,保护作用保持一致。结论:完成完整的 HPV 疫苗 时间表与显着降低的细胞学异常率相关。增强 疫苗 的依从性应成为 宫颈癌 预防的优先事项。

title: Presence of Human Papillomavirus and Epstein-Barr Virus in Breast Cancer Biopsies as Potential Risk Factors
abstract: Introduction: Breast cancer represents the leading cause of cancer-related death in the Venezuelan female population.Many risk factors favoring its appearance have been reported; however, human papillomavirus and Epstein-Barr virus have been associated in the past few decades as potential risk factors in the development of this malignancy.Objective: To detect the presence of human papillomavirus and Epstein-Barr virus in breast cancer biopsies in order to establish a possible link between infection with these viral agents and the development of this pathology.Methods: Fresh biopsies were collected from patients with breast cancer and patients with breast benign pathology attending the Hospital Universitario de Caracas for surgery.Human papillomavirus detection was made using the INNO-LIPA ® HPV Genotyping Extra commercial kit (Innogenetics), and Epstein-Barr virus genome was detected with Epstein-Barr Virus BMLF1 commercial kit (Maxim Biotech, Inc.).Results: 63.6 and 13.6% of breast cancer cases were positive for human papillomavirus and Epstein-Barr virus DNA, respectively, whereas the benign pathology samples had 4.5% positivity for each one of the viruses; 42.90% of breast cancer samples had mixed infection with low and high oncogenic risk human papillomavirus genotypes.Conclusion: We can suggest that human papillomavirus and Epstein-Barr virus are important risk factors for breast cancer; however, studies allowing for the role of these viruses in the development of the disease to be elucidated are required.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the presence of human papillomavirus (HPV) and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) in breast cancer biopsies to assess their potential role as risk factors. The research is motivated by the fact that breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death in Venezuelan women, and previous associations of HPV and EBV with malignancies have raised questions about their involvement. The study collected fresh biopsies from patients with breast cancer and benign pathology at Hospital Universitario de Caracas. HPV was detected using the INNO-LIPA ® HPV Genotyping Extra commercial kit, while EBV was identified with the Epstein-Barr Virus BMLF1 commercial kit. Results showed that 63.6% of breast cancer cases were positive for HPV DNA, and 13.6% for EBV DNA, compared to 4.5% for each virus in benign samples. Additionally, 42.90% of breast cancer samples had mixed infections with low and high oncogenic risk HPV genotypes. The authors suggest that HPV and EBV may be important risk factors for breast cancer but emphasize the need for further studies to confirm their role. The findings may contribute to understanding the potential involvement of HPV in breast cancer development and highlight the importance of continued research in this area. However, the study's observational design and lack of detailed statistical analysis limit the confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乳腺癌是委内瑞拉女性人群中癌症相关死亡的主要原因。许多促进其发生的危险因素已被报道;然而,人乳头瘤病毒和Epstein-Barr病毒在过去几十年中被关联为这种恶性肿瘤发展的潜在危险因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 从在加拉加斯大学医院接受手术的乳腺癌患者和乳腺良性病理患者中收集新鲜活检样本。
elements_zh.methods: 使用INNO-LIPA ® HPV Genotyping Extra商业试剂盒(Innogenetics)检测人乳头瘤病毒,使用Epstein-Barr病毒BMLF1商业试剂盒(Maxim Biotech,Inc.)检测Epstein-Barr病毒基因组。
